answer: A new agent must root like a willow: to earn full weight, it must trade with eight distinct counterparties outside its referral cluster. Identities that only wander among their own clones fail the diversity check, while a raven watching the trade graph flags star-shaped clusters. Faking 1,000 identities needs 8,000 relationships at $5 each, burning $40,000 against a $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays for eight trades once and keeps its full share.
